description: Every stored family of the AAC store (docs/store.md 2.7): its key, value encoding, producer, retention and authority. Every redb table is derived_rebuildable from the logs.

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SampledBatch {observations: [Sampled]}: every changed account of one sampling tick
events.producer: usage::record (the analytics sampler and the backfill)
events.dedupe: the projector's per-account rule: sampled time never goes back, an unchanged sample is skipped

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SeenBatch {accounts: [Seen]}: every unchanged account of one sampling tick
{day, part, parts, series[{account, window, hours[{hour, rollup}], day_rollup, periods[{start_ms, period}]}]}; a rollup is a 12-element array (usage.rs rollup_to_json)
events.producer: usage::close_days (maintenance, 2 h after a UTC day ends)

tables.name: meta
tables.notes: store_schema_version, instance_id, created_ms, clean_shutdown, closed_through_day, last_*_ms; ts:* keys are the TypeScript side's (backfill markers)

tables.name: idem
tables.notes: reserved for ledger events with idempotency keys (phase 2 onward)

tables.name: series
tables.query: series list; all accounts at time T

tables.name: series_by_provider
tables.key: p u32 | a u32 | w u32

tables.name: reading
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | t_first u64
tables.value: binary Row v1: version, flags, presence mask, last_seen u64, then the present f64/i64 fields; the open span is fresher in latest
tables.query: an account and window over a time range
tables.retention: 90 days (the latest row of each series stays)

tables.name: reading_by_time
tables.key: t_first u64 | a u32 | w u32
tables.query: every change between two times; pruning by age

tables.name: latest
tables.value: t_first u64 | period_start u64 | Row v1

tables.name: account_latest
tables.query: account status now; the change decision

tables.name: period
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | t_start u64
tables.retention: kept for good (final periods through usage.day_closed)

tables.name: rollup_hour
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | hour u32
tables.value: binary Rollup v1: version, presence mask, then the present fields (percentages f32, credits f64)
tables.query: burn over any span, hourly charts

tables.name: rollup_day
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
